onePageSummary:
Market Mood: VOLATILE

Global Cues: S&P 500 -0.82%, Nasdaq 100 -1.21%, Dow Jones -0.44%, Nifty 50 -0.22%, Bank Nifty +0.18%, GIFT Nifty -0.38%, Nikkei 225 +0.51%, Hang Seng -0.34%, Shanghai Composite +0.12%, KOSPI -0.27%, Taiwan Weighted +0.44%, Straits Times -0.16%, ASX 200 +0.23%, US Dollar Index +0.34%, Brent Crude +1.64%

Narrative Themes:
- Negative Macro Impact: Treasury yields gained Monday as traders looked out for more U.S. factory data, while monitoring developments in the Middle East.
- Global Risk-Off Cue: Fed chair nominee Kevin Warsh is putting his own spin on the independence of monetary policy. Many former Fed officials aren't sold.
- Global Earnings & Risk Appetite: Palantir reported better-than-expected revenue and profit, driven by growth in sales to U.S. government agencies.
- Sector-Specific Cushion: Palantir earnings beat expectations on the heels of explosive demand in the company’s core U.S. market.

Validated Trading Setups:
- NIFTY BULLISH entry 22705, stop 22180.26, target 23859.42 (RR 2.2)
- BANKNIFTY BULLISH entry 50960, stop 49292.6, target 54628.28 (RR 2.2)

Educational note: This summary is for market research and content preparation only, not financial advice.
